verdict.rationale: The auto-review docs cover each element of the story: disabling reviews globally, re-enabling them by keyword or label, limiting them to certain branches, skipping draft PRs, and pausing after a set number of commits. On-demand control is documented through @coderabbitai commands to request manual, incremental or full reviews and to pause, resume or ignore reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these trigger filters work as documented (all evidence is first-party docs).
